name: pumi-herdr
description: herdr's API and terminal attach on pumi: its CLI and its mobile apps drive pumi's panes and show them live.

session.label: herdr session
session.desc: The name pumi answers as among herdr's sessions (`~/.config/herdr/sessions/<name>/`), so herdr's CLI and its mobile apps (Heeler: the Host's session name) reach it. `default`: herdr's own default session (`~/.config/herdr`), where a running herdr server keeps it unless it has stopped. Empty: only pumi's data directory.

default_keys.label: herdr's keys
default_keys.desc: While herdr runs, bind the prefix table (`C-b` then a key) herdr's way: `v` and `-` split, `h` `j` `k` `l` move, `1`–`9` pick a tab.
